title: Midnight Winter Vinyl
body: The Midnight Winter Vinyl is a vinyl disc that comes with the Frozen Vinyl Player after it is unboxed from the Gift of Frozen Beats. The vinyl when played creates snowflakes which fall from the sky. When stopped, the music which is heard whenever on the property stops, as well as the snowflake effect. This is a limited time item only obtainable during the 2024 Christmas Event.
